import torch.nn as nn
import torch.utils.data

class DL_Model(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):

        self.bn3 = nn.BatchNorm2d(32)
        self.relu3 = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.concat1 = nn.Concat('mask')

        # Second block
        self.branch1 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(32, 16, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(16),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        )
        self.branch2 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(32, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(16),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        )
        self.branch3 = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(32, 16, kernel_size=1, stride=1, padding=0),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(16),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(16, 16, kernel_size=7, stride=1, padding=3),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(16),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True),
            nn.Conv2d(16, 16, kernel_size=3, stride=1, padding=1),
            nn.BatchNorm2d(16),
            nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        )
        self.avgpool = nn.AvgPool2d(kernel_size=8, stride=1, padding=4)
        self.concat2 = nn.Concat([self.branch1, self.branch2, self.branch3])
        self.flatten = nn.Flatten()

        # Fully connected layers
        self.fc1 = nn.Linear(16 * 8, 128)
        self.bn_fc1 = nn.BatchNorm2d(128)
        self.relu_fc1 = nn.ReLU(inplace=True)
        self.fc2 = nn.Linear(128, 10)

    def forward(self, x):
        # First block
        x = self.conv1(x)
        x = self.bn1(x)
        x = self.relu1(x)
        x = self.conv2(x)
        x = self.bn2(x)
        x = self.relu2(x)
        x = self.conv3(x)
        x = self.bn3(x)
        x = self.relu3(x)

        x1 = self.branch1(x)

        x3 = self.branch3(x)
        x_pool = self.avgpool(x)
        x_pool = self.flatten(x_pool)
        x = torch.cat([x1, x2, x3, x_pool], dim=1)

        # Fully connected layers
        x = self.fc1(x)
        x = self.bn_fc1(x)
        x = self.relu_fc1(x)
        x = self.fc2(x)
